title: An observed computation segment
statement: Let $N$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with state set $Q$, let $F\subseteq\mathrm{Option}(Q)$ be a set of stopping states, let $P$ be a property of the vector of work-tape head positions, and let $a$ be a configuration with fixed input $x$. Suppose that at every time $u<t$ the state of the run from $a$ lies outside $F$, and that at every time $u\le t$ the work-tape head positions satisfy $P$. Then the run from $a$ for $t$ steps is a segment ending at the configuration reached at time $t$, avoiding $F$ before time $t$ and satisfying $P$ through time $t$.
